# Tabula Rasa mission cross-reference

Generated 2026-10-18, extended 2026-10-20 (Wayback round 2: official site + patch notes, fan sites, forums, TR MMO DB). One entry per mission identity in the 1.16.5.0 client (`data/game.zip` → `generated/client/missionconversation.pyo`, `missionobjective.pyo`, `language/english/missiontextlanguage.pyo`). Each entry joins the external sources by mission title.

**Implemented** (enabled on the local server, `data/rasaworld.db`; marked `[implemented]` in the entry heading): 116 missions. Per zone: Wilderness 64, Plateau 34, Bootcamp 5, Abyss 1, Ashen Desert 1, Crucible 1, Descent 1, Divide 1, Howling Maw 1, Incline 1, Marshes 1, Mires 1, Palisades 1, Plains 1, Pools 1, Thunderhead 1. Search for `[implemented]` to find them; entries without the mark are not implemented yet.

**Missing mechanic** (cannot be built or completed as in the original game until the server has the mechanic; marked `[missing mechanic]`, list in `tools/mission-crossref/NOTES-missing-mechanics.md`): 34 missions.

**Goal in instance** (given on a public map, but cannot be completed without an objective inside an instance map; marked `[goal in instance]`, list in `tools/mission-crossref/NOTES-instance-goals.md`): 5 missions.

**Needs playtest** (implemented, not yet played through in the game client; marked `[needs playtest]`, list in `tools/mission-crossref/NOTES-playtest.md`): 31 missions.


**Instance** (the mission takes place in a client instance map, a "mission context" in gamecontext.pyo; marked `[instance]` in the entry heading): from an objective NPC package that spawns in an instance (local DB), a TaRapedia NPC page in an instance, or client objective text placing it there. "Instance mentioned" lines only name an instance (ESTIMATE). Refresh with instance_export.py.


Internal/test client identities (no player content expected): 60. Player-facing missions with no external source found: 84. Missions named by a source but absent from the client: see the last section, "Not in the 1.16.5.0 client" (67).

Notes: client text is shipped presentation only; it does not prove availability, rewards or prerequisites. TaRapedia values are community-reported and many pages are flagged incomplete. "Local server" values are this server's current migrated data, which includes explicit reconstructions (see `Rasa.NET/docs/wilderness-missions.md`). A `fuzzy` / `base-title` match means the external title differs slightly from the client title; check it. "Where" and "Drops" lines are sentences pulled automatically from the cited source (coordinates are in-game /loc values); narrative leveling guides can mention a neighbouring mission's NPC in the same sentence.

Find a way through the processing plant and scout out the situation at the top of the mountain. Naimi will radio you with further instructions once you've reached the landing pad.

Use the Door Security Console to unlock the doors leading to the Juggernaut Bay below.; Get Past the Juggernauts — Use one of the Juggernaut maintenance consoles in this room to get past the Juggernauts in the room below without a fight.; Bomb the Outpost Generator — You set off the siren and alerted the Bane's dropships as you reached the landing pad. Plant the bomb to destroy the Outpost Generator at the landing pad. …; Find the Landing Pad — Find a way to the Bane Landing Pad through Gotha Processing Plant.; Locate Bane Central Administration — Locate the Bane Central Administration building.; Defeat Overlord Kretas; Activate Kretas' Teleporter — Use Kretas' hand to activate the teleporter. Once the teleporter has been activated, it can be used to teleport back to Indra Watch Post near the exit to Indra …; Report to Major Diren
- **TaRapedia** [Desistance](https://tabularasa.fandom.com/wiki/Desistance): giver: Scout Hansa Naimi; at: Indra Caverns; zone: Ashen Desert; requires: None; follow-up: None; XP: 120,000; credits: 9,000; reward from: Major Darkua Diren
  - overview: On his way in, Scout Naimi spotted a Bane landing pad and what appears to be a security base for Gotha Processing Plant. Find a way through the processing plant and scout out the situation at the top of the mountain. Naimi will radio you with further instructions once you've reached the landing pad.
  - objectives: • Unlock Juggernaut Bay Doors • Get Past the Juggernauts • Find the Landing Pad • Bomb the Outpost Generator • Locate Bane Central Administration • Defeat Overlord Kretas • Activate Kretas' Teleporter • Report to Major Diren
  - walkthrough: Go left at the first fork when you enter Gotha, which will eventually take you to some catwalks and a tangled mess of corridors. One of the paths in the tangled mess takes you to control rooms overlooking the Juggernaut bay, from which you can reprogram the Juggernauts and open the bay doors. Once in the Juggernaut bay, the south exit eventually leads up to the landing pad and generator. Overlord Kretas is in the building off the landing pad.

This should be a smattering of Caretakers, Fithik, Altered Miasmas, and Thrax Tunnelers. Vandeweghe will speak to you once more, puzzling over where the queen is, and finally send you back to Petrovich. Return all the way to the Food Storage chamber …

  - objectives: • Destroy Bane Override Generator • Destroy the first Bane Override Generator • Destroy Bane Override Generator • Destroy the second Bane Override Generator • Destroy Bane Override Generator • Destroy the Third Bane Override Generator • Destroy Bane Override Generator • Destroy fourth Bane Override Generator
  - walkthrough: A small incline nearby Sergeant Fonseca will bring you to the base. The mission is not as difficult as it's made to be. Several Thrax Soldiers, Caretakers, and Thrax Technicians guard the small outpost. In addition, the boss Overseer Xyyl, an elite Technician, is guarding it. With a little work, they can be cleared out. Ascend the stairs to the top of the station and destroy the four small generators nestled there. Return to Major Phych.

  - overview: •; Destroy the three Bane Sub-Sonic Relay Arrays. Once all are destroyed, return to Sergeant Fonseca in the field.
  - objectives: • Destroy Sub-Sonic Relay Array 1 • Destroy Sub-Sonic Relay Array 2 • Destroy Sub-Sonic Relay Array 3
  - walkthrough: Down in Toma Springs should be three objectives. These are the Sub-Sonic Relay Arrays. Each is on top of a bunker, and the bunkers are filled with a smattering of Thrax Soldiers, Caretakers, Thrax Technicians, Linkers, and one elite Technician. You can destroy the arrays from a range, however, and these enemies are largely avoidable. The most dangerous part of the mission are the level 48-50 Striders that wander the area. Heavy AFS forces often occupy their fire, however, and you can potentially slip past or help them take the Striders down.

- **TaRapedia** [Infection Rejection](https://tabularasa.fandom.com/wiki/Infection_Rejection) [stub]: giver: Colonel Sherk; at: Gangus Outpost; zone: Howling Maw; level: 49; requires: Soil Samples; follow-up: Recent Discovery; XP: 300,000; credits: 10,000; reward from: Colonel Sherk
  - overview: •; Go to the Death Burrows and navigate through the tunnels until you find the source of the high concentration of Infection. Destroy the source once found and then return to Colonel Sherk with a full report.
  - objectives: • Search the Death Burrows • Search the Death Burrows for the Infection source. • Destroy the Infection Pumps • Destroy the Infection Pumps deep within the Death Burrows. • Infection Pumps Destroyed x 5 • Kill Bane Biogeneticist • Kill the Bane Biogenetcist Ynphluenxa. • Biogeneticist Ynphluenxa Killed x 1
  - walkthrough: Return to the Death Burrow and take the path on the east side of the ravine. Enter the cave and follow it all the way north. Exit, cross the bridge to the north, and enter another cave. Follow the cave slowly twisting down. Eventually you will exit at the bottom of the ravine. To the north is a Bane outpost, so approach it. Once close enough, the last two objectives will trigger. You'll have to kill a Boss Caretaker and take out five Bane Pumps. Once done, return to Colonel Sherk. Hopefully you have a portable waypoint.

  - walkthrough: The Atta in this hive are more erratic than the last. Grubs will sometimes attack for no reason. Waves of Atta will attack as if drawn from all over the hive by combat with one group. There will be large areas of no Atta as well, and unlike the last hive there seem to be no burrowing Atta attacks. Use ice or photonic attacks, Atta are immune to fire, many are immune to physical in this hive. For Grenadiers, try using a combination of Rage and Scourge abilities when you get mobbed by Atta packs. It will definitely help you fend off their swarm assaults. It is not necessary to kill the …

Therefore, this option is very important. Other choice will make player to fight through the front door to complete missions inside Bane Refueling Station. If you choose to steal the supplies, you don't have to go to both bases to get them. They spawn in a very short period of time so you can grab them from just one base faster than going to both.

At such time the mission will complete. Watch out for the Nitroglazers... even though they are in there keeping the reactor temperature down they won't hesitate to attack.
  - objectives (client): Shut Down the Reactors — Carefully make your way through the reactor chambers to the primary generator and destroy it.
- **TaRapedia** [It's All In the Timing](https://tabularasa.fandom.com/wiki/It%27s_All_In_the_Timing): giver: Sergeant Wolfe; at: Energy Weapons Center; zone: Mires; requires: None; follow-up: Tesla Inversion; XP: 31,000; credits: 5,600; items: Vextronics Electric Polarity Gun 3; reward from: Headquarters
  - overview: Take a left at the first intersection and find the entrance to the reactor chambers. Avoid the beams at all costs, and destroy the generator at the far end. Watch out for the Nitroglazers... Even though they are in there keeping the reactor temperature down they won't hesitate to attack.
  - objectives: Shut down the reactors • Carefully make your way through the reactor chambers to the primary generator and destroy it.
  - walkthrough: As the overview says, just take left at the intersection. Kill the Bane forces in the first room, go right and you'll get to the two reactor chambers. As the plasma beams fire in alternating sequence you move through the chambers when the other beam is firing. Being in a chamber while the beam is firing will kill you instantly. When you get to the reactor room, take care of the Nitroglazers first. That will make the cooling units explode... After that the reactor can easily be destroyed with EMP bombs or weaponry.

- **TaRapedia** [Tesla Inversion](https://tabularasa.fandom.com/wiki/Tesla_Inversion): giver: Headquarters; at: Energy Weapons Center; zone: Mires; requires: It's All In the Timing; follow-up: Look Before You Sabotage; XP: 33,000; credits: 5,800; items: ChiTech Virulent Injector Gun 3; ChiTech Pulse RPG Launcher 3; reward from: Headquarters
  - overview: Find the Bane datablade in the primary research lab and use it to sabotage the Tesla coil field.
  - objectives: Find the Datablade • x/1; Trigger the Tesla Inversion • Bring the datablade to the Tesla monitoring console
  - walkthrough: This mission is very straight forward. Continue further into the instance from the reactor chamber, into the room where Overseer Xirnon is located.   - objectives: Collect Kennilaxx's Head: • Collect 1 Kennilaxx Head Collect Howler Heads: • Collect 7 Howler Heads
  - walkthrough: The Howler Kennilaxx can often be found around the River-base Krimm. Two common spawning locations are just east of the base's north gate (45, 344), and on the trail from the south gate, near a wrecked Bane mining machine. Although a random spawn he is most commonly seen just North of River-base Krimm crossing the path to the north gate heading west. The easiest way to find Howler enemies is the Shard Ships trail and the area around "Waypoint: Firebase Tango" where they are very common with Hunters. Rewards: image:Off_with_there_heads.gif

Once you have all the ingredients, take them to Information Spec. Gooding at the Research Base Camp (37, -292).

Once you kill the queen and recover the artifact, you return to Brumley at The Dig Site for your reward. Agreed. It is easier if you kill the Matriarch first before you set the lure. Kill her, grab the artifact, head back up and set the lure. That way you don't have to wade through a bunch of Warnets to get to …

- **TaRapedia** [Temple of the Bowed Patriarch](https://tabularasa.fandom.com/wiki/Temple_of_the_Bowed_Patriarch) [stub]: giver: Warden Tyne; at: Walk of Giants; zone: Palisades; requires: Proven Commitment; Temple of the Proud Patriarch; follow-up: Temple of the Patriarch Protector; XP: 20,000; credits: 2,700; items: Vitalius Rocket Launcher; (modified, min lvl 15); Teleract Electric Net Gun; (modified, min lvl 16); Teleract Electric Polarity Gun; (modified, min lvl 18); reward from: Warden Tyne
  - overview: Enter the Temple of the Bowed Patriarch and accept the challenge.
  - objectives: • Speak with Warden Tyne inside the first area next to a medical vendor • Inside 2nd area with platforms, choose one of 2 NPCs to save from Holographic Bane forces (2x lvl 21 Thrax and 2x Xanx).   - walkthrough: In the first room, talk to the hologram. In the second room, you are given a choice between saving one of two Foreans - an Elder and a Youngling. If you fall, you'll have to deal with a number of Xanx. Be aware that taking the time to kill the Xanx may not be the best idea.   - walkthrough: It's probably a good idea to have the Firebase Tango Teleporter Waypoint before you embark on this mission because it is timed, to an extent. The mission will fail if and when the Bane recapture River-Base Krimm. It may be best to do this mission just after you capture the base or have fended off an attack wave. When you accept the mission, get to the Firebase straight away. Once you get there, you will be redirected to the LZ to the southeast. This then becomes an escort mission to the entrance of Devil's Den. I out-leveled this area by quite a bit when I tried it, so it was a breeze, but …

  - walkthrough: Note: You cannot teleport to the Staging Point or you will fail the mission. Entering any teleport, Drop Ship Pad or instance will fail the mission. Once you reach Captain McShay, your mission will complete.

  - objectives: Find and report the electric disturbance:
  - walkthrough: The objective is to enter the Hive, then proceed down the path over the bridge to the first bunker. You will be attacked by 2 Atta mobs. 2 other mobs are non-violent, so only fight those targets that target you to save resources. Into the bunker to the first chamber, you will be met by 3 Lightbenders. Kill them and enter the inner chanmber to reach the console and other NPC's who will give you additional missions. Don't forget to activate the Transporter (and step into it). Your other missions will take you to other bunkers with transporters as well.

The mini-bosses are tough kills for non-Commando types and it is recommended that one squad up to complete this chain or advance to higher experience levels before undertaking it. The Queen is incredibly difficult to kill and she is well protected …

  - overview: Kill twelve Tomb Miasmas and six Elder Tomb Miasmas at the Forean burial ground atop Mount Reverance. Return to Loremaster Talisen at New Velon Village when you have complete the task.
  - objectives: Kill 12 Tomb Miasmas • Tomb Miasmas killed 0/12; Kill 6 Tomb Miasma Bulls • Tomb Miasma Bulls killed 0/6
  - walkthrough: Miasma are found at Vogren's Tomb. Typically only 4-5 bulls spawn at one time. Respawn rate is about 5 minutes. Remember that Miasma's are vulnerable to electric damage and immune to cold damage. They also phase out when damaged and cannot be damaged again until they rematerialize. The best attack is a strong Lightening bolt followed by shotgun blast. Wait until they rematerialize then repeat the attack. Do not use high rate of fire weapons such as pistols, polarity guns, leech guns and chainguns.

  - walkthrough: Goliath patrols with two-to-four other Kael in the area immediately east of AFS Camp Resistance. The pack tends to patrol between the ruins and about halfway to Camp Resistence. Remember Kael are most vulnerable to electric damage, then photonic; they are immune to fire and physical damage. Virulent and cold damage are also effective.

  - walkthrough: • The Mad Bomber is located at the pit of the Eastern Chamber. To get to it, go back up the trail from Ellen towards the instance portal, but just a little ways. Look for a branch to the right. Take it and fight your way down the downhill slope. When you enter the Eastern chamber take the time to note the number of canisters along your path. These are proximity mines. Tanks about level 35 should suffer few ill effects, but lower ranks, and possible those with light armor should be cautious. The Mad Bomber has a fighting style similar to a Thrax Grenadier boss.

- **Client:** Lt. Chester located at the East Listening Post in Valverde Pools wants you to steal several supplies and destroy the Bane data servers from the Thrax Barracks.
  - objectives (client): Collect Thrax Ammo — Collect Thrax Ammunition from the Bane Barracks; Collect Plasma Capacitors — Collect Plasma Capacitors from the Bane Barracks; Collect Nutrient Paste from the Bane Barracks; Destroy Thrax Ammo Data Server — Destroy the Bane Data Sever located near the Thrax Ammunition dump.; Destroy Plasma Capacitor Data Server — Destroy the Bane Data Sever located near the Plasma Capacitor storage location.; Destroy Nutrient Paste Data Server — Destroy the Bane Data Sever located near the Nutrient Paste storage area; Additional Ammo — This is for One Man's Trash if active.
- **TaRapedia** [Smash and Grab](https://tabularasa.fandom.com/wiki/Smash_and_Grab): giver: Lieutenant Chester; at: East Listening Post; zone: Pools; level: 35; requires: Eastern Listening Post; follow-up: Spoils of War; XP: 130,000; credits: 7,200; items: Shinobi Laser Chaingun lvl 33; Vitalius Cryogenic Net Gun lvl 36; Vitalius Electric Polarity Gun lvl 33; Eclipse Laser Rifle lvl 36; reward from: Lieutenant Chester
  - overview: • Lt. Chester located at the East Listening Post in Valverde Pools wants you to steal several supplies and destroy the Bane data servers from the Thrax Barracks.
  - objectives: • Collect Thrax Ammo • Collect Plasma Capacitors • Collect Nutrient Paste from the Bane Barracks • Destroy Thrax Ammo Data Server • Destroy Plasma Capacitor Data Server • Destroy Nutrient Paste Data Server
  - walkthrough: The items needed are in the two main buildings. There are bosses in each of the buildings. In addition, the Supplymaster and his guards spawn in one of these buildings, so the number of enemies can immediately rise. This is particularly the case in the building housing the computers. The object is to move quickly into the main central room and on to an upper level. This way you can control the number of foes you face. Remaining in the hall will subject you to crossfire from respawning Bane troops.

  - walkthrough: This mission is the introduction to the Retread Caves instance. Kaethi Rose is just a short way inside the Retread Caves. You may encounter some brief resistance while getting to her. Although this mission does not have a formal follow-up mission, its the natural lead-in to Mox Clearing issued by Ellen Lenee who stands adjacent to the reward giver. She even comments that Col. Washington sent you to them.

  - walkthrough: Walkthrough: Instruct Corporal Sheen to go to the infirmary (Send her to the first aid office.) and use her computer terminal in her absence. It can also be obtained, apparently, by talking to Corporal Sheen directly if you have remained too close to her.

Bane consistently respawn at the cave exit so move out after you kill the first mob.

Logos are an essential element of the game, made all the better if / you actually get Mission rewards for finding them (but you can find logos without a / mission – see the Giddy Gamer site for a list of Logo locations, and a list of which logos / are actually required for the career path you’re following – many of the logos you / discover do not yet have a purpose in the game). Logos power your Abilities, and they / also open Portals. / d. Take note of the 2 trainers – you’ll need to return to one of them to advance to level 5. / e. Check out the Crafting Station in one of the tents – see Part II for details (complicated). You don’t / need to learn crafting to progress, and crafting level is only improved by adding (precious) Skill / points, not by practice, so we suggest ignoring crafting for the first while. Your backpack Crafting / slot will eventually start to fill up – this is a good time to stop and consider how much crafting you / want to do. / 14. Get training and a Clone at Level 5. When you reach level 5 (actually, at the top of level 4), you may only / advance to level 5 by selecting a “Tier 2” career – either Soldier or Specialist, from a Soldier Trainer or a / Specialist Trainer. As you are about to select your career path, the trainer will offer you a chance to Clone / yourself. Choose [Yes] – and then take the Level 4.99 clone along the opposite career path at some later / time (if you like). Tier advances (and free clones) only happen at levels 5, 15 and 30. / 15. Explore. Missions should send you further and farther afield, but don’t be afraid to explore on your own. / During Beta testing, all zone maps and their features were visible to characters from level 1. We don’t / expect this to be true in the Final release, so you’ll need to explore to find new settlements and additional / waypoints, vendors, and missions. / Revision Date: 2007/11/04”

  - walkthrough: Go to Ranja Gorge. Follow the stream, up river, to Enigma Falls. Behind Enigma Falls is Enigma Cavern. Use the fire pit to open the door. Follow the path to the hole in the floor. Jump down, and go straight to the door. Use the fire pit to open it, and leave.

### 1960 — Convert: 100 Assault Tokens --> 100 Prestige

- **Rebuild summary:**
  - level: not found (not critical)
  - reward: not found (not critical)
  - drops / mission items: not found (not critical, or not a collect mission)
  - location: zone Unknown zone only
- **Client:** The CP Token Banker is offering you a chance to exchange 100 Assault Tokens for 100 Prestige Points. Speak to the banker when you wish to have the conversion done.
  - objectives (client): Ensure that you have 100 Assault Tokens in inventory — The CP Token Banker requires that you have 100 Assault Tokens in your inventory to handle the exchange.
- **Web:** giver: CP Token Banker — Deployment 8 (May 2008) replaced Assault/Defense Token vendors with Prestige Vendors and placed a token banker next to every Prestige Vendor. The Token Banker converts tokens into Prestige via 1 of 8 missions (4 for Assault tokens, 4 for Defense tokens), and offers none if you have no tokens. Sources: [TaRapedia: Updates/2008-05-14 (Deployment 8 patch notes)](https://tabularasa.fandom.com/wiki/Updates/2008-05-14), [TaRapedia: Prestige](https://tabularasa.fandom.com/wiki/Prestige)

  - walkthrough: This mission is easy and straightforward. There are plenty of Young Forest Boargar on the south-western side of Alia Das. Kill them, collect their tusks, and once you've got 6 intact ones (the cracked ones don't count!), bring them to Warrior Apirka to receive your reward. Boargar are neutral creatures and will not attack unless they are under attack. They are weak melee fighters, so you shouldn't have a problem to kill them unless you aggro too many at a time. They are especially susceptive to sonic damage, so if you have a sonic weapon, use it against them. This mission is best combined …

## Client mission text that no client mission references

The 1.16.5.0 client `language/english/missiontextlanguage.pyo` holds 161 texts longer than 60 characters that are not referenced by `missionconversation`, `missionobjective` or `objectiveconversation` (duplicates removed below). They can be objectives of removed or changed missions, older wording, or Targets of Opportunity titles. Source of every line: the client file and text id shown. "Related client missions" is an ESTIMATE: client missions whose texts name the same NPCs or places.
